item.title: Manpage Monday: bastille rdr
item.content:encoded: Manpage Monday: bastille rdrRedirect a host port straight to a jail. No hand-editing pf.conf.Forward TCP traffic from host:80 to jail:80> bastille rdr myjail tcp 80 80Bind the redirect to only a specific interface:> bastille rdr -i vtnet0 myjail tcp 80 80Limit the redirect to a single source IP:> bastille rdr -s 200.200.200.200 myjail tcp 80 80

item.title: Privacy and security on computers was always always thoroughly neglected. It is no longer nearly as viable to continue doing so and dismissing it as only mattering in targeted attacks.
item.content:encoded: Privacy and security on computers was always always thoroughly neglected. It is no longer nearly as viable to continue doing so and dismissing it as only mattering in targeted attacks.The vulnerabilities being discovered were nearly entirely already there and it's a good thing they're getting found and fixed. Many years of technical debt must be repaid. Decisions such as monolithic kernels and massive codebases written in C and C++ must be repaid. We have to somehow keep users safe through it.

item.title: LLMs are a massively disruptive technology causing a lot of harm and information security is one of the areas most impacted by it. It has been heavily adopted for offense and defense. It's very scary how good the latest models are at finding vulnerabilities and even developing exploits for those. It isn't viable for GrapheneOS to pretend that isn't the case and skip protecting our users from it. There's an ongoing crisis for privacy and security but attackers only have a temporary advantage.

item.content:encoded: Directing endless hate towards us with lies, misrepresentations, bullying and vitriol is not going to convince us that we've made any incorrect decision in our approach to this. We believe we're doing a large amount of good with our approach and that it massively outweighs the harm.AI is being used to harm our users with far more powerful surveillance tech, rapid vulnerability discovery, rapid exploit development and much more. item.title: Many of the recent threads attacking us are doing so with fabricated stories where they falsely claim we've covered up how we use technologies. In reality, these attacks started because we've been transparent.
item.content:encoded: Many of the recent threads attacking us are doing so with fabricated stories where they falsely claim we've covered up how we use technologies. In reality, these attacks started because we've been transparent.The recent attacks began when we replied to a question about how we use AI. After the attacks began, we made a top-level thread explaining our AI policies and how we arrived at those:We believe it's the right approach for us minimizing harm and maximizing good.

item.title: We strongly believe in privacy including for financial transactions. People should expect nothing less from a privacy project.
item.content:encoded: We strongly believe in privacy including for financial transactions. People should expect nothing less from a privacy project.It should be obvious we aren't fans of traditional banking and financial services built to enable mass surveillance.We also aren't fans of unencrypted blockchains and believe those should be fixed.We believe in the privacy of cash being preserved in the same way we believe in people's private conversations and thoughts being protected.

item.title: Cryptocurrency enables us to reliably pay a team distributed around the world. It has provided the majority of our funding and is how we're able to run GrapheneOS as a non-profit entirely funded by donations. Many other privacy projects also receive the majority of their donations via cryptocurrency.

item.title: Our father, who art in source control,
item.content:encoded: Our father, who art in source control,hallowed be thy `main`.Thy merges come, thy builds be done,downstream as it is upstream.Give us each day our detached HEAD,And forgive us our rebases,as we forgive those who rebase against us.And lead us not into submodules,But deliver git-send-email.For thine are the commits, the trees and the blobs,For ever and ever, --amend.
